LessonBrook dùng tài khoản Google để đăn: LessonBrook uses Google sign-in and stores your account ID, name and email to associate your ledger with you. You can edit your teacher name and add bank transfer details.
Sổ lưu học viên, lớp và danh sách tham g: Your ledger stores students, classes and participants, prices, lessons, statements, payments, appearance preferences and correction history. Contact names, phone numbers and notes are optional information you enter. Only enter what you need for teaching and tuition reconciliation.
Dữ liệu được xử lý qua máy chủ LessonBro: Data is processed by LessonBrook's server on Vercel, using Google Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore for sign-in and storage. Operators have the administrative access needed to provide support and resolve incidents.
Bạn xem trước nội dung công khai rồi chủ: You preview the public content and explicitly enable sharing. Anyone with the link can view and forward it without an account.
Link hiển thị tên giáo viên và người nhậ: The link shows the saved teacher and recipient names, statement number, dates, fee lines, total due, recorded payment dates and amounts, and remaining balance. Bank details appear only if you chose to include them.
Email, điện thoại, ghi chú nội bộ và dữ: Email, phone numbers, internal notes and other students' data are excluded from shared pages. Received amounts are the teacher's records, not bank confirmations.
Link mặc định hết hạn sau 30 ngày. Bạn c: Links expire after 30 days by default. Revoke or replace them from the statement. Revocation blocks subsequent access; recipients may retain screenshots or content they already viewed.
Cookie cần thiết giữ phiên đăng nhập tối: Necessary cookies maintain your session for up to 5 days and protect save operations. You can sign out or sign out all devices in Settings. Sign out after using a shared device.
Ứng dụng giữ lịch sử thao tác trong sổ đ: The app retains ledger activity history for reconciliation and minimal technical information to diagnose errors and prevent automated access. Shared statements do not load third-party analytics. LessonBrook does not send Zalo messages, read bank transactions or automatically confirm transfers.
, chọn xuất từng nhóm CSV hoặc toàn bộ d: and export individual datasets as CSV or all data as a ZIP containing CSV and JSON. Exports include archived records, cancelled statements and voided payments.
File tải xuống thuộc trách nhiệm lưu giữ: You are responsible for keeping downloaded files safe. The pilot cannot import exported files; store any records you need privately.

Bạn có thể lấy dữ liệu trước, rồi yêu cầ: You can download your data first, then request deletion in Settings. The app requires confirmation and reauthentication with the same Google account. When deletion starts, all your shared links stop working and the ledger is locked for deletion.
Quy trình xóa học viên, buổi dạy, bảng k: Deletion removes students, lessons, statements, payments, payment details, ledger history and your LessonBrook sign-in account. Your Google account is not deleted. Once confirmed, the request cannot be cancelled.
Nếu bị gián đoạn, mở lại trang tiến trìn: If interrupted, reopen the deletion progress page to continue. The system retains a minimal technical marker to resume the request and prevent old operations from recreating data; it contains no name, email or tuition amounts and currently has no automatic deletion deadline.
